market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH currently ~$2,275 on Apr 28-29, 2026. The 2026 low so far was ~$1,750 in early 2026 (post Aug 2025 ~$5K peak), so the $1,500 level has not yet been hit. Reaching $1,500 requires another ~14% drop from the low or ~34% from spot, with 8 months remaining. ETH has underperformed BTC and remains weak; another drawdown is plausible but not a base case given how far it has already fallen.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether ETH continues underperforming BTC or stabilizes from here
